scheduleAInfo.description: Senior Managing Director of Guggenheim Treasury Services since 2018. Prior to Guggenheim, Mr. Spencer was an Executive Director at UBS where he was head of structuring for the US structured financing business. Prior to UBS, Mr. Spencer was a Vice President at BNP Paribas in fixed income structuring.

Chief Legal Officer and Managing Partner of Guggenheim Partners since 2019. Prior to that Mr. Khuzami held several senior-level positions in both, the public and private sectors. 2018-2019 Mr. Khuzami served as Deputy United States Attorney in the United States Attorney's Office for the Southern District of New York. 2009-2013 he served as Director of Division of Enforcement of the United States Securities and Exchange Commission.
Head of Corporate Accounting and Senior Managing Director of Guggenheim Partners since 2005.
Senior Managing Director of Guggenheim Treasury Services, LLC since 2001.
Senior Managing Director of Guggenheim Treasury Services since 1997.

Director of Guggenheim Treasury Services (GTS) since 2018. Prior to joining GTS, Mr. Lewis was an Assistant Vice President at Nuveen working in the Investment Risk group. Mr. Lewis joined Nuveen out of business school prior to which he worked at Eldorado Trading Group as a proprietary trader focused on interest rates futures.
Managing Director of Guggenheim Treasury Services, LLC since 2003.
